agent_explanation: Two-body close encounter drives failure: bodies fall from separation ~4.47 to 0.50 (comparable to softening 0.3), speeds rise to ~13.5, kinetic ~651 and potential ~-783. Fixed-dt leapfrog with only 1->9 substeps cannot resolve the sharp pericenter acceleration/turnaround; energy drifts monotonically from -102.25 at step 0 to -102.19 at step 98, -113.43 at step 99, -132.23 at step 100, breaching the 2% tolerance. Reducing dt alone restores conservation, confirming timestep-resolution cause, not NaN or momentum error (momentum conserved).
